designDetails.silhouette: One lean adult Red-caste Warrior, not a Red King: elongated ridged eyeless dome carried forward, narrow ribbed thorax and waist, long forearms, powerful digitigrade legs, four readable dorsal tubes and one long articulated spear-tipped tail. Preserve a bipedal hunter silhouette rather than royal bulk or Prowler posture.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale bone carapace; cool ash-gray and gray-beige biomechanical recesses; restrained translucent rose-taupe soft tissue; charcoal-brown mouth and joint cavities; wet highlights and metallic ivory/silver teeth. Red remains a lineage label, not a saturated body color; at most use very low-chroma iron-rose in soft-tissue seams, never a vermilion shell.
designDetails.surface: Keep the dome ridges, rib cage, tendons, dorsal tubes, limb plates and tail segmentation organic, wet and individually readable. Re-author every mark; do not apply a white filter to the red predecessor or lift linework from the comic master.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless ridged head with telescoping inner jaw, one narrow ribbed torso, exactly two long clawed arms, two digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one continuous segmented spear-tipped tail. No crown, eyes, clothing, weapon or mechanical part.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay side profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses. Dome, jaws, claws, feet, all four dorsal tubes and the entire tail remain inside their own cell; no frontal turn, camera rotation, mirroring or perspective drift.
designDetails.scale: Use the reviewed base dome-to-ribcage, shoulder-to-pelvis and proximal-limb relationships as anatomical guidance only. The base historical final-pack scale is 0.653061224, but scaleCalibrationReview is null and scaleCalibrationEvidence is empty; neither it nor nominal per-clip values is inherited. The 071 sources require a new measured all-clip, 32-pose calibration.
designDetails.root: Track a stable pelvis/lower-ribcage landmark and project it to the actual planted support foot, or to the terminal body plane after collapse. Preserve authored vertical displacement while keeping the root independent of dome tip, reaching claws and tail. Tail tip, cross-cell fragments and legacy bounds centers never define the physical root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, comic panel, hive resin, text, logo or grid.
